title: demote() does not reset lowest_rank
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Lines 301-308. The demote() function clears role, parent, rank, and parents map, but does NOT reset lowest_rank. If the node later rejoins (becomes non-root), the stale lowest_rank from its root tenure could affect MaxRankIncrease calculations. Edge case: Root at rank 256 demotes, lowest_rank stays 256. Node rejoins at rank 1024 via DIO. New parent with path_cost 1024 > 256 + max_rank_increase(1024) = 1280 would be admissible, but path_cost 1281 would not - even though the node never achieved rank 1280 as a non-root. Consider resetting lowest_rank in demote().
